department.instructions: Which team should handle this message?

criteria.sales: Pricing, upgrades, new accounts, plan questions
criteria.account: Login, password, profile, permissions, data deletion
criteria.other: Anything that does not fit the other teams

frustration.instructions: How frustrated does the sender appear?

is_urgent.instructions: Does the message convey urgency or time-sensitivity?

criteria.true: Explicitly time-sensitive, blocking, or losing money

sentiment.instructions: Overall sentiment of the review toward the business.

main_topic.instructions: What is the review mainly about?

criteria.product_quality: Quality of food, products or the work delivered
criteria.price_value: Prices, value for money, hidden fees
criteria.wait_time_speed: Waiting time, speed of service, delays, queues
criteria.other: Anything else or no clear topic

is_complaint.instructions: The review describes a negative experience or complaint.

actionable_feedback.instructions: The review describes a specific problem the business could fix or a concrete suggestion.

would_return.instructions: The reviewer indicates they would return, recommend, or come back.

business_size.instructions: Estimated size of the business based on the listing.
criteria: Solo operator or single very small location
Established business with several locations or a franchise

customer_type.instructions: Who does this business mainly sell to?

is_independent.instructions: The business is an independent local business rather than a chain or franchise.

has_website.instructions: The listing includes a website URL.

online_presence.instructions: Strength of the online presence based on website, review count and rating.
criteria: No website and few or no reviews
Basic presence: website or a handful of reviews
Solid presence: website and dozens of reviews
Strong presence: website and hundreds of reviews with a high rating

criteria.mid_level: Individual contributor without a level qualifier, specialist, consultant
criteria.senior: Senior, staff or principal individual contributor
criteria.lead_or_manager: Team lead, manager, head of a team
criteria.director: Director, head of department, senior director
criteria.c_level: CEO, CTO, CFO, COO, CMO, chief anything, president

department.instructions: Functional area of the current role.

criteria.data: Data science, analytics, machine learning, BI
criteria.sales: Sales, business development, account executive, partnerships
criteria.marketing: Marketing, growth, content, SEO, communications, PR
criteria.operations: Operations, supply chain, logistics, procurement, admin
criteria.executive: General management, C-suite, founder without a functional focus
criteria.other: Anything else, e.g. healthcare, education, arts

is_decision_maker.instructions: Holds budget or purchasing authority: director level and above, founder, owner or head of a department.

is_technical.instructions: Has a technical background (engineering, data, IT, science).

open_to_opportunities.instructions: The profile explicitly says they are open to work, hiring, or new opportunities.

company_size.instructions: Company size. Use the employee count if given, otherwise infer from the description.

criteria.marketplace_platform: Marketplace or platform connecting buyers and sellers
criteria.agency_services: Agency, consulting, professional or outsourced services
criteria.ecommerce_retail: Selling physical goods online or in stores

is_startup.instructions: Describes itself as a startup, early-stage, or venture-backed company.

is_tech_company.instructions: Technology is the core product rather than a supporting function.

sentiment.instructions: Overall sentiment expressed in the post.

content_type.instructions: What kind of post is this?

criteria.promotional: Promotes a product, service, sale or brand
criteria.question_poll: Asks the audience a question or runs a poll

is_sponsored.instructions: The post is sponsored, an ad, or a paid partnership (for example #ad, #sponsored, "paid partnership", "gifted").

has_call_to_action.instructions: Asks the reader to do something: click a link, buy, sign up, comment, share, follow.

is_brand_safe.instructions: Free of profanity, hate, adult content, violence, drugs and political controversy.

criteria.true: Safe for any brand to appear next to
criteria.false: Contains content a brand would avoid

intent.instructions: What is the commenter trying to do?

criteria.question: Asks a question or requests information
criteria.purchase_intent: Wants to buy, asks about price, availability or where to get it
criteria.tagging_friends: Just tags or mentions other users
criteria.other: Anything else, including plain reactions or emojis

needs_reply.instructions: A brand or creator should reply to this comment.

is_spam.instructions: The comment is spam, a scam, or unrelated promotion.

is_toxic.instructions: Contains insults, harassment, hate speech or threats.

main_topic.instructions: What is the review mainly about?

criteria.quality_durability: Build quality, materials, how long it lasts
criteria.customer_service: Seller or brand support, returns, refunds
criteria.accuracy_of_description: Matches or differs from the listing photos and description

mentions_defect.instructions: Describes a defect, malfunction, damage or the product not working.

would_recommend.instructions: The reviewer recommends the product or would buy it again.

is_suspicious.instructions: Generic, repetitive or unnatural text that suggests a fake, paid or incentivized review.

criteria.mid_level: 2-5 years of experience, no seniority qualifier

criteria.onsite: In the office or on location

requires_degree.instructions: A university degree is listed as required.

salary_disclosed.instructions: A salary or pay range is stated.

is_technical_role.instructions: The role is in engineering, data, IT or another technical field.
